caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair set against a plain, light beige background. The chair features a dark brown color with a high, arched backrest that includes an intricate openwork splat with a central carved motif and curved vertical slats. The seat of the chair is depicted as a lighter, straw-colored woven material, showing clear diagonal weaves. The chair rests on four straight legs, connected by horizontal supports near the base. The drawing is centered on the paper, with no additional objects or background details present.
title: Dining Chair
